text:
Miguel: Quick recap from today's vendor sync — we need to lock allocations for the next 6 months. vendor said lead times are 12-16 weeks for the 80GB cards.

Asha: 12-16 weeks is rough for Dedicated customer commitments. Do we have any buffer stock?

Jing: DC ops inventory shows ~24 spare blades but only 8 with compatible power headers for the 80GB form factor. If we convert 16 blades we can create a ~64-GPU buffer pool, but that's disruptive during maintenance windows.

Olav: Confirmed from vendor: current allocation cap for our account is 240 GPUs per quarter. Pricing unchanged for Q2 but they warned of surcharges for expedited air freight. Standard terms are FCA, can do DDP at +3% on invoice.

Miguel: Any chance to shift some Dedicated commitments to smaller 40GB units to cover latency-sensitive workloads? Cost delta?

Asha: 40GB helps for embeddings loads but we lose perf for long-context chat. Also increases orchestration complexity. Let's quantify cost delta first.

Olav: Pricing examples they sent: 
```
80GB A100-equivalent: $10,500 per unit (ex-works)
40GB: $6,200 per unit (ex-works)
Air-expedite fee per shipment: ~$18k (typical 20-30 GPUs)
RMA advance swap stock fee: $1,500 per unit
```

Priya: FYI finance: expediting will blow the Q2 capex model. We can absorb some via OpEx if vendor issues credit notes for returns, but lead-time premium needs approval.

Jing: Also data-residency constraint: EU customers require GPUs shipped to EU DCs. Vendor's EU allocation is tighter — said 60 GPUs available across our EMEA accounts for April/May.

Miguel: That means we must prioritize EU Dedicated customers and consider rerouting NA non-sensitive workloads to 40GB or shared hosted pool. Agree?

Asha: Agree. Can eng-platform prepare a policy for automated routing fallback when model doesn't require 80GB? Tagging @Priya for billing implications.

Priya: Noted. We'll draft billing rules for mixed-fleet usage and a one-time surcharge for expedited hardware.

Olav: On RMA/logistics: vendor can offer advance replacement program (ARP) but requires an RMA-deposit for fleet size > 50. Process: vendor ships replacement, customer returns defective within 30 days with RMA case. No cross-region advance swaps — returns must come back to origin RMA depot.

Miguel: How much is the RMA-deposit?

Olav: Typical deposit = 20% of replacement units value, refundable upon confirmed return. For our projected ARP of 100 units, deposit est = $210k.

Jing: That deposit impacts working capital and customs (import/export) paperwork. Also, if returns are to non-EU depot, we'd face additional VAT/HS code handling. Need customs team sign-off.

Miguel: Can vendor point ARP depot location?

Olav: Primary depots: NA: Memphis (TN), EU: Rotterdam. APAC: Singapore (limited). ARP origin must match shipping region.

Asha: For urgent clusters with failing cards we might need temporary reassignments. Can we use hot-swap policy + limited cloud burst to vendor-hosted test GPUs?

Olav: Vendor offered temporary cloud-access for diagnostics (no inference SLA) for up to 72h per RMA case, complimentary for accounts on contracts.

RMA-Bot: New RMA case template created — case ID: RMA-2026-0458. Please attach serials and failure logs.

Miguel: Case noted. Attaching a sample serial list and PO for the ARP deposit: 
```
PO: PO-77841-REDWOOD-APR26
Deposit wire ref: TBD (finance to confirm)
Serials: SN-80G-000234, SN-80G-000235, SN-80G-000238
```

Priya: I'll get treasury to prep wire instructions. Expect 3-5 business days to clear. We should schedule replacement shipments after confirmation.

Jing: Logistics note — freight forwarder needs HS code 8471.60 and temporary import docs for ARP. If returns delay beyond 30 days, vendor charges retention fee equal to 10% of unit value.

Asha: Risk assessment: if we lose 40-60 80GB GPUs for >6 weeks, customer SLAs could degrade. Proposal: approve ARP deposit for 100 units, convert 32 blades to buffer pool, and allow automated routing to 40GB for non-critical traffic.

Miguel: Vote? +1 from me.

Jing: +1 if maintenance windows are scheduled.

Priya: +1 pending finance approval for the deposit.

Olav: I'll submit the ARP contract addendum and target allocation uplift request to vendor ops. Expect formal quote by EOD Friday.

Miguel: Thanks everyone. Action items: Priya -> finance wire prep; Olav -> formal ARP quote + depot IDs; Jing -> schedule maintenance for blade conversions; Asha -> prepare routing policy draft. We'll reconvene Friday to finalize. :thumbsup:
